Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The players are out in the middle. Smriti Mandhana and Shafali Verma will open the batting for India Women. Issy Wong will begin the proceedings with the ball. Let's go!
... THE RUN CHASE ...

England Women on the other hand will be happy with how things have concluded for them. At one stage 200 was looking a bit far-fetched, but the middle order has done well to get them well over the 200 mark. Danni Wyatt and Alice Davidson-Richards were the two batters who were majorly responsible for getting England Women to a par total. Danni Wyatt perished after a fine knock of 43, but Alice Davidson-Richards stay till the end and notched up her maiden half-ton. Sophie Ecclestone and Charlotte Dean too played good cameos which came eventually helped England Women put on a score of 227. They have given their bowlers something to bowl at now. Can they defend this target? We will find out. Stay tuned for the second essay.

After electing to bowl first, India got off to a bright start. Their pacers used the conditions perfectly and dismissed the English openers in succession. They capitalized on that and took 5 wickets at end of the 27th over and put England under the pump. However, they were unable to grab quick wickets towards the end and let England get away with a few partnerships. But overall it’s been a disciplined bowling show from the bowlers. India Women would fancy their chances of chasing this one down and taking the lead in this series.

It's been an exceptional recovery from England Women. They have managed to put a competitive total on the board and have a lot to fight with now. India will be a wee bit disappointed with how things have panned out in the latter half of the innings.

Fuller length, around off. Charlotte Dean tries to open the bat face and work it through short third man but a good stop keeps them to just for a single. And England Women posts a healthy total of 227/7.
2WIDES! Meghna Singh misses it line and strays it down the leg. Yastika Bhatia misses to stop that and a run is being taken.
Fuller length, around off. Alice Davidson-Richards tries to go big but misses it and Yastika Bhatia goes for the stumping but Alice Davidson-Richards is safe.

FOUR! Fifty for Alice Davidson-Richards. A much-needed knock for the England Women. That was a full toss deliver, around the middle. Alice Davidson-Richards heaves it towards deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Alice Davidson-Richards tries for a scoop shot but misses it. That was full, outside off. Alice Davidson-Richards misses the connect.
Fuller length, around off. Charlotte Dean pushes it towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
Fuller length, outside off. Charlotte Dean gets across the line and tries to go towards mid-wicket but misses it.

Two byes! Missed stumping! A shorter ball, this one stays low, down the leg side. Alice Davidson-Richards steps down and misses her slog. Yastika Bhatia fails to grab the ball as well. Two byes taken.
FOUR! Up and over! A fuller ball, around middle and leg. Alice Davidson-Richards steps down the track and hoicks it away from long on for a boundary.
Tad short in length again, around middle. Charlotte Dean whips it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Shorter ball, around middle. Charlotte Dean pushes it back to the bowler.
Loopy ball, full, around middle and off. Alice Davidson-Richards works it away towards mid-wicket for a single.
A fuller ball, around middle. Charlotte Dean pushes this one towards long on for a single.
Swing and a miss! Wide of off, a length ball. Alice Davidson-Richards looks to cut this one away but fails to get any bat on it.
A length delivery, around middle and leg. Charlotte Dean flicks it through mid-wicket and takes a single.
A fuller one, around off. Charlotte Dean pushes it back to the bowler.

FOUR! Streaky boundary! Outside off, on a length, extra bounce there as well. Charlotte Dean rocks back and looks to cut this one away, but the ball goes off the outside edge towards third man for a boundary.

DROPPED! A tough chance though. A fuller one, around middle. Charlotte Dean scoops this one towards short fine leg. Jhulan Goswami runs forward, puts in a dive, gets her hands on the ball, but fails to hold on to that one. Two taken.
On a length, around middle and off. Alice Davidson-Richards drags this one from the inner half of her bat towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Quicker ball, outside off, back of a length. Charlotte Dean rocks back and misses her cut. A dot to end the over.
Fuller ball, around middle, loopy ball. Alice Davidson-Richards heaves it towards mid-wicket and takes a single.
Outside off, short again. Charlotte Dean cuts it towards cover and takes a single this time.
Flatter ball, outside off, short one. Charlotte Dean cuts it towards cover.
Flighted delivery, full, around middle. Alice Davidson-Richards steps down the pitch and strokes it towards long on. That brings up the 200 for England Women!
Tossed-up delivery, around middle. Charlotte Dean turns it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Around middle, slower one, full in length. Alice Davidson-Richards once again reverse-sweeps it towards third man for a couple of runs.
Floated delivery, around middle, fuller one. Alice Davidson-Richards works it away towards mid-wicket.
Nice shot! A fuller one, tad slower, around middle. Alice Davidson-Richards gets down and reverse-sweeps it past short third man for a brace.
Drifting in, around middle and leg, short in length. Charlotte Dean rocks back and tucks it towards square leg for a run.
Full in length, around middle. Alice Davidson-Richards steps down the pitch and knocks it to long on for a single.
Fuller ball, loopy one, around off. Alice Davidson-Richards chips it towards cover. The fielder there collects the ball on a bounce.
FOUR! A good end to the over. Pooja Vastrakar bowls it fuller, outside off. Charlotte Dean opens the bat face and guides it past short third man for a boundary.
Fuller length, wide outside off. Alice Davidson-Richards knocks it to deep cover for a run.
Full toss delivery, outside off. Charlotte Dean knocks it to deep cover for a run.
Fuller length, around off. Alice Davidson-Richards punches it to deep cover for a run.
Fuller length, around off. Alice Davidson-Richards knocks it to deep cover for a couple.
Fuller length, around off. Charlotte Dean pushes it to cover for a run.
Four dots to end the over! Pitches it up again, darting it on the pads. Alice Davidson-Richards works it away towards mid-wicket.
Floats this one up, full, around middle and leg. Alice Davidson-Richards tucks it towards square leg. Another dot.
Back of a length, around off. Alice Capsey rocks back and looks to cut this one away, but the ball goes off the under edge back to the bowler.
Tosses it up again, full in length, around off. Alice Davidson-Richards dances down the pitch and knocks it past the bowler. The fielder from mid off will cut that one out. No run there!
Shorter ball, angling in, around middle and leg. Charlotte Dean works it away towards square leg and rotates the strike.
A loopy ball, full and outside off. Charlotte Dean rocks back and cuts this one late towards third man for a brace.

Fuller length, around off. Charlotte Dean pushes it towards cover and Alice Davidson-Richards wanted a quick single but Charlotte Dean sends her back and the fielder has a shy at the stump. This costs India Women an extra run.
Run out chance! There is a direct hit at the non-striker's end. But the replay shows that Alice Davidson-Richards was well in. Not out it is!
Charlotte Dean makes her way out in the middle.

OUT! Deepti Sharma strikes and a partnership has finally been broken. Deepti Sharma bowls it slower through the air, around the middle and leg. Sophie Ecclestone goes off to backfoot and tries to work it towards deep mid-wicket but misses it and the ball hits her back pad and That's out. The umpire raises her finger. Sophie Ecclestone goes for the review and it shows three red and she has to take a long walk back to the pavilion.
Fuller, outside off. Alice Davidson-Richards pushes it towards long off for a run.
Fuller length, around off. Alice Davidson-Richards knocks it to cover.
Fuller delivery, outside off. Sophie Ecclestone dances down the pitch and heaves it towards deep mid-wicket, falling short of the fielder.
Flighted delivery, outside off. Sophie Ecclestone pushes it towards cover.
Quicker, flatter, and straighter. Sophie Ecclestone strokes it down to long on and takes a run. She retains the strike.
FOUR! Poor ball and punished! Down the leg side, fuller ball. Sophie Ecclestone sweeps it towards fine leg for a boundary.
Short ball, outside off. Alice Davidson-Richards rocks back and cuts it towards point for a single.
Sophie Ecclestone takes the aerial route now, but the ball lands safely. A fuller ball, outside off. Sophie Ecclestone slices it over cover for a single.
Outside off, fuller in length. Alice Davidson-Richards pushes it through cover for a single.
Flights this one, serves it full, around off. Sophie Ecclestone advances down the pitch and looks to flick this one. But the ball goes off the outside edge away from point for a single.
Short, around off. Sophie Ecclestone pulls it towards deep mid-wicket. And a good over of Jhulan Goswami comes to an end.
Fuller length, outside off. Sophie Ecclestone pushes it to mid-off.
Tad shorter, outside off. Sophie Ecclestone knocks it towards the cover.
Short of length, around off. Alice Davidson-Richards pushes it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Fuller length, around off. Sophie Ecclestone hits it towards long on for a run.
On a good length, around off. Sophie Ecclestone blocks it back to the bowler.
Flighted delivery, around middle and off. Sophie Ecclestone advances down the pitch and lifts it over the bowler's head. Only a single.
Floats it up again, full, around middle. Alice Davidson-Richards works it away towards square leg for a single.
Tossed-up delivery, around middle, fuller one. Sophie Ecclestone steps down the pitch and miscues her heave towards deep mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! Second boundary of the over! Not the best ball from Sneh Rana. A fuller one, around the leg pole, loopy again. Sophie Ecclestone once again gets on one knee and sweeps it towards deep square leg this time for a boundary.
Tosses this one up, very full, around off. Sophie Ecclestone pushes it back to the bowler.

FOUR! Nicely done! Lovely placement from her! A fuller ball, around middle and off, loopy one. Sophie Ecclestone gets down on her knee and sweeps it in the gap between deep square leg and deep mid-wicket. Rajeshwari Gayakwad runs to her left, and puts in a dive but fails to stop the ball. A boundary.
Slower delivery, outside off. Sophie Ecclestone tries to block it but gets an outside edge and the ball rolls towards third man region and a run is taken.
Slower delivery, outside off. Sophie Ecclestone blocks it off the front foot.
Fuller length, outside off. Alice Davidson-Richards pushes it to long on for a run.
Tad shorter, outside off. Alice Davidson-Richards comes down the pitch and hits it towards cover.
Fuller length, outside off. Alice Davidson-Richards hits it towards the point.
On a good length, around off. Alice Davidson-Richards blocks it off the front foot.
Short this time, width on offer as well. Alice Davidson-Richards hangs back and cuts it towards backward point for a single. She retains the strike.
Well bowled! Very full on this occasion, around middle, loopy ball. Alice Davidson-Richards plays it back to the bowler.
Outside off, fuller one now. Alice Davidson-Richards leans forward and defends it towards cover.
FOUR! Welcome boundary! Sneh Rana spills this one around the leg pole, shorter ball. Alice Davidson-Richards rocks back and flicks it away from short fine leg for a boundary.
Outside off again, tosses it up, tad slower. Alice Davidson-Richards steps down the pitch and drives it past the diving fielder at short cover. Two taken.
A fuller ball, outside off. Sophie Ecclestone gets low and swipes this one towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
A tidy over for Jhulan Goswami comes to an end. Just 2 runs coming off it. On a good length, around off. Alice Davidson-Richards pushes it towards short mid-wicket.
On a good length, around off. Alice Davidson-Richards blocks it off the front foot.
Slower ball, around the pads. Sophie Ecclestone hits it towards deep square leg.
Yorker ball, on off. Sophie Ecclestone pushes it towards short mid-wicket.
On a good length, outside off. Alice Davidson-Richards pushes it to deep extra cover for a run.
Fuller length, outside off. Alice Davidson-Richards tries to cut it but misses it.
Attacking the stumps now, around middle and leg, fuller ball. Alice Davidson-Richards dances down the pitch and knocks it past short mid-wicket towards long on. A single to end the over.
Another dot! Pitched-up delivery, around off. Alice Davidson-Richards advances down the pitch and drives it to the fielder at mid off.
Tad shorter now, outside off. Alice Davidson-Richards shows the full face of the bat and pushes it towards cover.
Slower through the air, full, outside off. Sophie Ecclestone sweeps it through square leg and rotates the strike. 3 singles on the trot.
Loopy ball this time, fuller one. Alice Davidson-Richards skips down the pitch and knocks it towards long on. Another single is taken.
An off-break, around middle and off, short in length. Sophie Ecclestone stays in her crease and tucks it towards square leg for a single.
Fuller length, outside off. Sophie Ecclestone charges down the pitch and hits it towards long off for a run. Dot off a Free Hit!
NO BALL! Harleen Deol oversteps this time. Flighted delivery, around middle. Sophie Ecclestone knocks it towards mid-on. The umpire signals for a Free Hit.
Fuller, outside off. Alice Davidson-Richards knocks it to deep cover for a run.
Short, outside off. Sophie Ecclestone punches it through cover for a run.
Fuller length, around off. Sophie Ecclestone blocks it.
FOUR! Fuller length, around off. Sophie Ecclestone goes down on one knee and sweeps it to deep square leg for a boundary.
Flighted delivery, outside off. Alice Davidson-Richards pushes it through deep cover.

DROPPED! An opportunity gone! Not an easy chance though. A fuller ball, around middle and off. Sophie Ecclestone leans forward and chips it towards the right of the bowler. Deepti Sharma dives to her right, gets both her hand on the ball but fails to hold on to that.
Pulls her length back now, tad shorter, around off. Sophie Ecclestone blocks it out.
Fuller, outside off. Sophie Ecclestone knocks it back to the bowler.
Loopy ball, full, around middle and off. Sophie Ecclestone prods forward and blocks it out.
Sophie Ecclestone comes to the crease.

OUT! CLEANED UP! Deepti Sharma breaks this stand! India Women once again grab a wicket at a crucial time. A fuller, floated delivery, this one spins in after pitching, around middle and leg. Danni Wyatt gets down on her knee and tries to sweep this one but she misses. The ball goes on to knock the stumps. A good knock from Danni Wyatt comes to an end.
A fuller one, around middle. Danni Wyatt leans forward and blocks it out.
Loopy delivery, around off. Alice Davidson-Richards pushes it to mid-on.
Fuller length, around off. Danni Wyatt punches it towards deep cover for a run.
Loopy delivery, around off. Danni Wyatt knocks it towards the point.
Fuller, outside off. Alice Davidson-Richards knocks it to deep cover for a run.
Fuller length, around off. Danni Wyatt knocks it towards cover for a run.
FOUR! Poor delivery by Harleen Deol to start off with. That was short, around middle. Danni Wyatt goes on the back foot and slaps it between deep mid-wicket and square leg for a boundary.
Flatter, quicker, attacking the stumps. Danni Wyatt rocks back and tucks it towards square leg for a single.
Flighted delivery again, around middle and off. Alice Davidson-Richards skips down the pitch and knocks it towards long on for a single.
Fuller one, outside off, tosses it up. Alice Davidson-Richards prods forward and defends it out.
Back of a length, turning in, around middle and off. Alice Davidson-Richards goes on the back foot and works it away towards mid-wicket.
Fuller ball, down the leg side, loopy one. Danni Wyatt gets down on her knee and sweeps it towards square leg for a single.
Fuller ball, spinning in, around middle and leg, at 73 clicks. Danni Wyatt turns it away towards square leg. She wanted a single there, but decides against it.
Fuller length, around off. Alice Davidson-Richards knocks it back to the bowler.
Fuller length, around middle and leg. Danni Wyatt pushes it towards dep mid-wicket for a run.
FOUR! Fuller length, outside off. Danni Wyatt comes down the pitch and slices it over covers for a boundary.
Fuller length, around middle. Alice Davidson-Richards pushes it towards mid-wicket for a run.
Full, around off. Danni Wyatt goes down on one knee and sweeps it towards deep mid-wicket. A single taken.
Lofted delivery, outside off. Danni Wyatt pushes it to the point.
Outside off, fuller one. Alice Davidson-Richards lunges forward and defends it out.
FOUR! Much-needed boundary! Meghna Singh drops it short, around middle and off. Alice Davidson-Richards picks up the length and pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Slightly fuller, outside off. Danni Wyatt drives this one away from her body towards cover-point for a run.
Pushes her length slightly up now, serves it outside off. Alice Davidson-Richards punches it off the back foot towards cover. Single.
Another short one, around middle and off. Danni Wyatt pulls it towards deep square leg and rotates the strike.
A short ball, width on offer. Alice Davidson-Richards rocks and slaps it towards deep cover for a single.

DRINKS! India Women are on top of proceedings! They have grabbed wickets at regular intervals and have kept England Women under the pump. The hosts still have half their side and 21 more overs. Danni Wyatt and Alice Davidson-Richards will be looking to stitch a big partnership from hereon.
Fuller length, on leg stump. Alice Davidson-Richards goes back in her crease and glances it through square leg for a run.
Fuller length, on the middle. Danni Wyatt drives it to long off for a run.
Fuller length, around off. Alice Davidson-Richards opens the bat's face and guides it through point for a run.
Short, around off. Alice Davidson-Richards pushes it to the fielder at covers.
100 up for England Women. Short, around off. Danni Wyatt knocks it to cover for a run.
Short, around off. Danni Wyatt cuts it towards point.
This is onto the stumps, Danni Wyatt gets down on one knee and sweeps it behind square on the leg side for a single.
Sharma slows it up now and bowls it around off, Danni Wyatt plays it late and towards the point region.
Tossed up, outside off, Wyatt edges it down with soft hands towards backward point.
Excellent running! Around off, Wyatt waits for it and just plays it late, behind point and races back for the second.
Flighted delivery, full and on off, pushed towards cover.
Tosses it nicely does Deepti Sharma, full and outside off. Danni Wyatt opens the face of the blade and guides it past backward point for a couple of runs.
Alice Davidson-Richards is the new batter in.

OUT! BOWLED! England Women are in real trouble now. Rajeshwari Gayakwad bowls it slower through the air, around the leg stump. Amy Jones goes on the back foot and tries to heave it towards mid-wicket but the ball does not bounce as much as she was expecting. She misses her heave, the ball deflects off her pads and goes onto the hit the stumps. England Women have lost have their side!
Slower through the air, outside off. Amy Jones pushes it through the cover.
Loopy delivery, around off. Amy Jones blocks it comfortably.
Fuller length, around off. Amy Jones blocks it.
Short, around middle and leg. Danni Wyatt goes on the back foot and pushes it towards mid-on for a run.
Lofted delivery, outside off. Danni Wyatt knocks it to cover.
Fullish length, around off, pushed away towards covers.
Full and on off stump, firmly driven by Jones but straight towards mid off.
Fullish length, close to the off pole, driven square of the wicket for a run.
Goswami serves it on a nagging length and around middle and leg, Danni Wyatt watchfully keeps it out.
Length again, on middle and leg, tucked away behind square on the leg side for just a single.
Good length, top of the off stump line. Amy Jones punches it out towards short extra cover.
A successful over by Harleen Deol comes to an end. Fuller length, outside off. Amy Jones drives it through covers for a run.
Fuller length, outside off. Danni Wyatt cuts it through point for a run.
Fuller length, outside off. Amy Jones cuts it through cover-point for a run.
Amy Jones the skipper of England Women comes to the crease.

OUT! Harleen Deol scalps a big fish. Sophia Dunkley who was well-set at the crease departs. Harleen Deol bowls it slower through the air, outside off, full in length. Sophia Dunkley tries to loft it over cover but ends up chipping it to the fielder at cover. Deepti Sharma there takes a dolly. A soft dismissal and England Women are now 4 down.
Commentary.Howout: c Deepti Sharma b Harleen Deol

Commentary.Commentary: Slower through the air, around off, nicely flighted, very full. Sophia Dunkley slices this one towards the fielder at point.
Lofted delivery, outside off. Danni Wyatt knocks it towards cover for a run.
Pitched up on off stump, played out towards cover for another single.
Full and straight, Dunkley walks towards the ball and clips it towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
Goswami goes fuller and around off, Sophia Dunkley drives but straight towards cover-point.
Good length, pushed outside off, Danni Wyatt hangs back and guides it down to third man for a single.
Pitched up on middle, Wyatt strokes it away towards mid on.
Right on the money! Fullish length, shaping into middle, Danni Wyatt defends it late and under her eye line.
Jhulan Goswami (5-2-8-1) comes back to bowl!
Length delivery, on off. Danni Wyatt slaps it through the cover for a run.
Fuller, wide outside off. Sophia Dunkley drives it firmly to long off for a run.
Fuller length, around off. Danni Wyatt opens the bat's face and guides it to point for a run.

Short, onto leg. Danni Wyatt blocks it out towards square leg. She wanted a single but Yastika Bhatia was quick to reach the ball. She scores a direct hit at the non-striker's end, but Sophia Dunkley was well in.
Short, around off. Sophia Dunkley knocks it towards cover for a run.
Flighted delivery, wide outside off. Danni Wyatt does well to reach the ball and pushes it through cover for a run.
Harleen Deol is introduced into the attack.
Good running! Around off, played with gentle hands towards extra cover by Danni Wyatt for a quick single.
Tossed up, around middle, driven down to wide long off for a couple.
Flatter one, around off and staying a touch low, Dunkley cuts it in front of square on the off side for a run.

This is looped on, around middle and leg, Sophia Dunkley shuffles right across the stumps as she looks to paddle it fine. She misses though and gets hit on the pads. There is a huge appeal and the finger is raised. Dunkley has a word with her partner and opts to review. At first glance, it does look adjacent but UltraEdge shows that the ball has hit the gloves. The on-field decision is overturned and Dunkley survives.
Flatter this time, on off, Sophia Dunkley punches it off the back foot towards mid on.
Nicely tossed up, full and around off, Danni Wyatt drives it square of the wicket and picks up a single.
Tad Shorter, around off. Sophia Dunkley pushes it towards the short square leg.
Flighted delivery, outside off. Sophia Dunkley blocks it off the front foot.
Fuller length, outside off. Danni Wyatt knocks it towards cover for a run.
Slower through the air, outside off. Danni Wyatt knocks it to cover.
Short, around off. Sophia Dunkley tucks it towards cover for a run.
Flighted delivery, around off. Sophia Dunkley blocks it towards the bowler.
A single to end the over! Tosses this one up, fuller ball, around middle and leg. Sophia Dunkley advances down the pitch and knocks it towards long on. 2 runs off the over.
Four dots now! This time the line is outside off, short in length. Sophia Dunkley keeps this one out.
Three dots on the trot! Another short ball, around middle and off. Sophia Dunkley blocks it from within her crease.
This one comes in with the arm, quick through the air now, around off. Sophia Dunkley blocks it towards mid-wicket off the back foot.
Quicker now, around middle, around off. Sophia Dunkley rocks back and tucks it towards square leg.
Flighted delivery, fuller one, around off. Danni Wyatt leans in and pushes it towards cover for a single.
Short, around off. Danni Wyatt sweeps it towards deep square leg for a run.
Fuller length, outside off. Danni Wyatt pushes it towards the cover.
Slower through the air, spinning in. Danni Wyatt blocks it off the front foot.
Loopy delivery, outside off. Sophia Dunkley knocks it towards the point for a run.
Short, outside off. Sophia Dunkley blocks it.
Flighted delivery, outside off. Sophia Dunkley knocks it back to the bowler.
Slower this time, around the off pole, shortish ball. Danni Wyatt pushes it back to the bowler.

FOUR! This time just beats Jhulan Goswami at short fine leg! Loopy one again, around leg, fuller ball. Danni Wyatt gets down her knee and sweeps it away from short fine leg for a boundary. Danni Wyatt is off the mark with that!
Tosses this one up, down the leg side, fuller in length. Danni Wyatt sweeps this one towards short fine leg. Jhulan Goswami there makes a good stop.
Danni Wyatt walks in at number 5.

OUT! TAKEN! A stunning catch from Harmanpreet Kaur helps India get rid of the dangerous, Alice Capsey! Sneh Rana strikes and England Women have lost their third wicket. A fuller ball, around middle, tad quicker. Alice Capsey leans forward and flicks this one towards mid-wicket. Harmanpreet Kaur at short mid-wicket, dives to her right, sticks her right hand out and takes a terrific catch. Alice Capsey was just starting to get going and this is a big wicket for India Women!
Commentary.Howout: c Harmanpreet Kaur b Sneh Rana

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Welcome boundary for England Women! Slower through the air, full, around off. Alice Capsey shimmies down the pitch and slices this one over extra cover for a boundary.
Tosses this one up, serves it full, around off. Sophia Dunkley steps down the pitch and knocks it towards long on. A single!
Flighted outside off. Alice Capsey looks to sweep and misses through to the keeper.
Short of a length, outside off. Alice Capsey drives it straight to the cover fielder.
Fuller length, around off. Sophia Dunkley clips it towards mid on for a run.
Loopy delivery, outside off. Sophia Dunkley pushes it through covers for a couple.
Short, around off. Sophia Dunkley tucks it towards short square leg.
Deepti Sharma starts with a loopy delivery, outside off. Sophia Dunkley tries to cut it but misses it.
Fraction short, around middle and off. Alice Capsey hangs back and pushes it back to the bowler. A nice tight over from Sneh Rana comes to an end.
Outside off, fuller one. Alice Capsey advances down the pitch and pushes it towards extra cover.
Pitches it up, around middle. Sophia Dunkley goes back on that one and punches it towards long on for a run.
Tosses this one up, full, around off. Sophia Dunkley prods forward and blocks it out.
Quicker ball, short, around off. Sophia Dunkley goes back and works it away towards mid-wicket.
Quick single! A short one, outside off, quick as well. Alice Capsey dabs it towards cover-point and takes a single.
Quicker, flatter, around off. Sophia Dunkley rocks back and blocks it out.
Short ball, around middle, Alice Capsey advances down strokes it to long on. A single!
Full and outside off, loopy one as well. Sophia Dunkley knocks it to long off for a single.
This one comes in with the arm, shorter ball, around middle and leg. Alice Capsey stays in her crease and works it away towards square leg for a single.
Spinning away, flighted delivery, outside off. Alice Capsey chips it just away from the fielder at cover.
Full, around middle, Alice Capsey steps down and pushes it back to the bowler.
Overpitched, outside off. Alice Capsey drives it towards mid off. Meghna Singh dives to her left and makes a good stop. Single taken!
Touch shorter again, around middle and off, Alice Capsey pushes it back to the bowler.
Outside off, flighted delivery, fuller ball. Alice Capsey leans forward and blocks it out towards cover.
Very full this time, tosses it up, around off. Sophia Dunkley thumps this one down the ground for a single. That brings up the 50 for England Women!
FOUR! This time she will get a boundary! Fuller ball, around off, slower through the air. Sophia Dunkley gets down one her knee, shuffles across and paddles it towards fine leg for four runs.
Sneh Rana begins with a loopy ball, outside off, full in length. Sophia Dunkley shuffles across and scoops it towards fine leg. Two taken!

Drinks break! The India Women pacers were good in the first Powerplay and got rid of both the English openers. There was a bit of movement off the deck on offer and they made good use of it. England Women now have the in-form pair of Sophia Dunkley and Alice Capsey on the crease and would hope that they stitch together a big partnership. It will be interesting to see whether the spinners will have much effect on this surface or not. A fascinating middle phase awaits. With that said, Sneh Rana has been brought onto bowl.
Around the off pole, touch slower this time, slightly short as well. Alice Capsey plays it back to the bowler.
Tosses this one up, full, around off. Alice Capsey strides forward and blocks it out.
This one goes on with the arm, quicker ball, around off. Sophia Dunkley pushes it towards mid off and takes a single.
Drifting in, around middle and leg, shorter ball. Sophia Dunkley rocks back and blocks it towards square leg.
FOUR! Up and over! Fuller again, around off. Sophia Dunkley dances down the pitch and smokes it down the ground for a boundary.
Quicker, full, around middle. Sophia Dunkley advances down the pitch and blocks it out.

Another drive but there is protection in the deep this time! Fuller one, outside off. Alice Capsey leans into this fuller ball and drives it through cover. Two taken. A good over for England Women, 10 off it!
On a good length, around middle and off. Alice Capsey defends it out.
FOUR! Another gorgeous drive! Fuller one again, outside off. Alice Capsey strides forward and creams her drive past mid off for a boundary.
On a length, around middle and off. Alice Capsey blocks this one out off the back foot.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Pooja Vastrakar pitches this one up, outside off. Alice Capsey prods forward and caresses this one past the diving fielder at extra cover for a boundary.
Pooja Vastrakar begins with a good-length delivery, around off. Alice Capsey blocks it out from within her crease.
Change from both ends now as Pooja Vastrakar comes on to bowl.

A shorter ball, this one comes in with the arm, around middle and leg. Sophia Dunkley stays in her crease and looks to flick this one. But she misses and gets rapped on her pads. A huge appeal for LBW, but the umpire says no! Harmanpreet Kaur opts for a review. UltraEdge rolls in and shows there was a slight edge on that one. Sophia Dunkley survives. India Women lose a review.
Dot off a Free Hit! A full toss, outside off. Sophia Dunkley steps down and miscues her heave towards mid on.

No ball! A shorter one, spinning away, outside off. Sophia Dunkley shuffles across and pushes it towards cover-point. Rajeshwari Gayakwad has overstepped here and a no ball is called. Free Hit coming up.
Driting in this time, tad shorter, around her pads. Alice Capsey tucks it towards square leg for a single. Alice Capsey is off the mark on her debut!
Loopy ball, around middle, full in length. Alice Capsey prods forward and blocks it towards cover.
Slower through the air, outside off, fullish again. Alice Capsey leaves it alone.
Rajeshwari Gayakwad begins with a fuller ball, tosses it up, around off. Alice Capsey leans in and pushes it towards cover.
Time for Powerplay 2! Now, 4 fielders can be placed outside the inner circle till the 40th over. Also, Rajeshwari Gayakwad comes into the attack. She replaces Jhulan Goswami.
Fullish delivery, on off, this is driven straight back to the bowler.
FOUR! This time Sophia Dunkley does get it in the gap. Length again but there's width on offer. Dunkley plays this one a touch late and slaps it in between point and backward point for a boundary.
Firmly struck but for no run. Length delivery, outside off, Sophia Dunkley crunches this one towards point where the fielder makes a sharp stop.
Nagging length from Meghna Singh, on the fourth stump line, Dunkley plays it with soft hands and towards point.
Around off, Dunkley tentatively plays it out on the off side.
WIDE! Length this time, pushed well outside the off stump, wide signalled.
Around off, Sophia Dunkley walks towards the ball and punches it straight back towards the bowler.
Pitched up this time, on off, Alice Capsey blocks it out. End of a wicket-maiden by Jhulan Goswami.
Length ball, around off, pushed away onto the off side.
Alice Capsey walks out to bat on her ODI debut!

OUT! LBW! Fantastic delivery by Jhulan Goswami and both the English openers have now perished! This is fuller and around middle, the ball nips back in sharply off the surface. Tammy Beaumont gets pushed onto the back foot and plays completely down the wrong line. The ball pings her onto the pads and there's a loud appeal. The umpire raises the finger and Goswami gets her first wicket of the game.
Full and angling onto middle, this is driven straight towards mid on.
Angling into the pads, Beaumont works it leg side but finds the fielder at square leg.
This is served on a nagging length and around the fourth stump line, Tammy Beaumont goes on the back foot and edges it down towards gully.
Excellent over from Meghna Singh, just the wide and a wicket off it as well. Full and outside off, jammed out towards backward point by Dunkley.
WIDE! Singh tries to go full and wide again but pushes it a bit too wide.
This is angled in fuller and around off, Dunkley walks towards the ball and hits it with the swing towards mid off.
Keeps it full and in that channel around off with the ball shaping away. Sophia Dunkley makes yet another leave.
Fuller and wider, Dunkley doesn't play at it.
Fullish length, outside off and taking it away from the right-hander. Sophia Dunkley leaves it alone.
Sophia Dunkley walks out to bat at number 3.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Meghna Singh has bounced Emma Lamb out and India Women have their first wicket! A surprise short one from Singh, bowled at a good pace and height as well. Lamb looks to take it on but she gets hurried on. The ball takes the edge and Yastika Bhatia behind the sticks makes no mistake. Lamb departs for a low score and it is a bright start for the visitors.
Commentary.Howout: c Yastika Bhatia b Meghna Singh

Commentary.Commentary: Full and around off, driven firmly towards cover but the fielder over there makes a good half stop. Just the single then and it has been a sedate start so far for England Women.
WIDE! Full and just sliding down the leg side, Lamb misses the flick and a wide is called.

Oh, risky attempt from Tammy Beaumont but luckily for her, she survives. This is angled onto the pads, Beaumont shuffles and looks to reverse-ramp it over short third man. The ball goes off the top edge and towards backward square leg. They get a single.
Length again, on off stump, Emma Lamb works it away to the left of mid-wicket and rotates the strike.
Nagging length, around middle, Emma Lamb stays on the back foot and eases it towards mid on.
Length again, around off, Lamb looks to cut but mistimes it towards cover-point.
A length ball, nipping in off the deck from around off. Emma Lamb hops back and blocks it out.
Make that four dots! This one angles in, around middle, on a length. Tammy Beaumont blocks it out. Just 2 runs off that over!
Shaping away, outside off, on a length. Tammy Beaumont stays in her crease and cuts it towards backward point. Three dots on the trot!
Tighter line now! Around the off pole, another length delivery. Tammy Beaumont pushes it towards cover.
A good-length delivery, outside off, Tammy Beaumont hangs back and blocks it out.
This is full and around off, Beaumont drives it towards extra cover. Pooja Vastrakar dives to her right and parries it towards mid off. The batters race back for two.
Singh serves it a bit fuller and around off, Beaumont reaches out and plays it towards point.
Perfect line and a top over from Goswami comes to an end, it's a maiden! A tad fuller and floated up on off stump, Lamb looks to flick but gets a leading edge that doesn't carry to the bowler.
Just a fraction shorter and over middle, Lamb hops and nudges it towards mid-wicket.
Nagging length from Jhulan Goswami, around the fifth stump line and angling in. Emma Lamb goes on the front foot and blocks it out.
Length ball, outside off, played on the up but straight to the fielder at cover-point.
Pitches it up now, around off and Lamb pushes it out towards cover.
Good length, close to the off stump, Lamb backs away and taps it towards point.
Around the top of off, Tammy Beaumont solidly defends it out.
Good length, around off, Emma Lamb taps it towards cover where there's another fumble by Pooja Vastrakar and the batters cross over.
Length ball, pushed wide of off stump and shaping further away, left alone by the batter.
Beaten! Fuller and outside off, shaping away beautifully. Lamb leans in and has a dab at it but gets beaten past the outside edge.
FOUR! Easy pickings for Emma Lamb! Length, angling down leg, Lamb just eases it into the square leg fence.

Misfield! Singh angles it onto the pads and shapes the ball away from the right-hander. Beaumont looks to play it leg side but gets a leading edge towards point where Pooja Vastrakar fumbles and allows the single.
Back of a length, outside off, Lamb leans back and plays it straight towards point.
On a nagging length and on off, this one jags back in sharply. Emma Lamb gets pushed onto the back foot but manages to keep it out.
Around the hips, Beaumont shuffles down the track and works it 'round the corner for a single.
Fullish length, around off, blocked off the front foot.
Beaumont pre-meditates and shuffles down the track. Goswami drags the length back and bowls it on off, Beaumont defends it out.
Early call for two and they get it with ease. A tad shorter and on middle, Beaumont tucks it away past square leg and opens her account with a brace.
Nicely timed but equally well stopped. Fuller and outside off, Lamb leans in and drives it to the left of extra cover where Smriti Mandhana makes a good diving stop.
Nagging length, on off and shaping away, Lamb eases it out on the off side.
FOUR! Too full and too straight from Singh and Emma Lamb dispatches it for the first boundary of the day. This is on middle and leg and it is caressed through wide mid on for a boundary.
Very full, on off stump and moving in the air, Lamb does well to keep it out.
Lovely delivery! Singh angles this one in on a length and into off stump, the ball swings away a long way. Emma Lamb gets drawn into the shot but the ball zips past the outside edge.
Nice shape to start with. Meghna Singh starts off with a fuller one, around off and the ball shapes away beautifully, Lamb lets it through to the keeper.
Meghna Singh will share the ball with Jhulan Goswami.
A dot to end a tidy first over by Goswami, just 1 run off it. This is full and outside off, the ball nips away this time as Beaumont plays inside the line of the ball.
Just a tad bit fuller on this occasion and nipping in from around off, Beaumont defends it out with a straight bat.
Nicely bowled! Good length again, tighter on off stump and this one nips back in sharply. Beaumont manages to keep it out.
Good length, shaping it in from around off, Tammy Beaumont punches it out towards short extra cover.
Emma Lamb and England Women are underway! Shorter and there's width on offer as well, Lamb plays it uppishly through backward point and collects a single.
Goswami starts off with a gentle-paced delivery, a touch fuller and outside off. Emma Lamb looks to stroke it through covers but gets beaten past the outside edge.

We are all set for action to get underway! The umpires have made their way out in the middle. India Women are seen in a huddle near the boundary ropes. Tammy Beaumont and Emma Lamb will open the batting for England Women. Jhulan Goswami will begin proceedings with the ball. Let's play!

Alice Capsey is all set to make her maiden ODI appearance for England. At just 18 years of age, she has shown the world her talent. A clean striker of the ball who has an array of shots under her belt, Alice Capsey is a sure superstar in the making!

England Women (Playing XI) - Emma Lamb, Tammy Beaumont, Sophia Dunkley, Alice Capsey (On debut), Danni Wyatt, Amy Jones (C/WK), Alice Davidson-Richards, Sophie Ecclestone, Charlotte Dean, Kate Cross, Issy Wong.

India Women (Playing XI) - Smriti Mandhana, Shafali Verma, Harleen Deol, Harmanpreet Kaur (C), Yastika Bhatia (WK), Deepti Sharma, Pooja Vastrakar, Jhulan Goswami, Sneh Rana, Rajeshwari Gayakwad, Meghna Singh.
TOSS - India Women have won the toss and they have elected to BOWL first!

England Women on the flip side will be coming into this game high on confidence after their T20I series victory. They will be aiming to carry on with their winning momentum. In the absence of Heather Knight and Nat Sciver, Amy Jones will be leading the side in the ODI series as well. Alice Capsey and Freya Kemp, the two young stars who impressed one and all in the shortest format, are a part of the longer format as well. We could probably witness the two of them make their debut. Will we see them in the playing XI? We will have to wait to find out. Stay tuned for the toss and other updates.
